outcome: receipt of postpartum depression treatment (psychotherapy and/or antidepressant medication)
cohort: The study included 25,976 women aged 12-55 years enrolled in Texas Medicaid who had a postpartum depression diagnosis and were continuously enrolled from 84 days pre-delivery to 12 months post-delivery.
finding: Over 75% of women with postpartum depression received treatment, and the likelihood of treatment receipt was significantly associated with age, race, urbanicity, prenatal care, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with an increased likelihood of receiving postpartum depression treatment.
